Make Your Move

Extraordinary experiences in the real world. New career pathways. A community where unconventional is the convention.

Got Questions? Visit Us Learn How to Apply

what do a waffle iron, a fish, and a mushroom say about oregon

Find Out

150 People
and Counting

The UO’s notable people have left their mark for over 150 years. They've made breakthroughs, challenged convention, and created lasting traditions. Get to know the scientists, artists, leaders, scholars, and athletes who have shaped the university and world beyond.

Meet 150+ Unstoppable Ducks

Impact Accelerated

Oregon research dares to ask bold questions, then fast-tracks discovery into everyday life. The payoff: $3.7 billion in economic impact statewide, across science, health, education and the humanities.

Discover Oregon’s Impact

How to Help After a Concussion

Get expert advice on supporting kids and adults recovering from a concussion.

See Support Tips

UO Research Goes Abroad

A volcanologist, a geophysicist, and a computer scientist are taking their work overseas as Fulbright Scholars.

Meet the Researchers

Should You Trust That Photo?

A UO media scholar offers six questions to ask when evaluating images in the AI era.

Learn to Analyze AI Images

Student Designs Take Off

Architecture students develop conceptual plans for the Eugene Airport expansion with help from alumni architects.

Explore the Project

Go Beyond the Classroom

Restore oyster beds with coastal tribes. Develop new therapies for osteoarthritis. Or re-create a classic song. Put your skills into practice and gain real-world experience through internships, research, and even student clubs and organizations.

Get Hands-On with Experiential Learning

Get Set to Soar

Undergraduates: Whether you have a destination in mind or want to explore your options, your academic path starts here.

Explore Degrees Browse by Area of Interest

A Program for Every Goal

With more than 100 graduate programs to pick from, you’ll gain the skills and experience you need to have an impact on the world.

See Graduate Studies

It's a Eugene Thing

There’s something for everyone at the UO. Ducks stay active exploring the outdoors, cheering at games, and finding new interests through hundreds of clubs and organizations.

Explore Student Life

Ever Tried Taiko?

From Japanese drumming to disc golf, our 450-plus affinity groups are a great way to try something new.

Student Organizations

Experience the Great Outdoors

Since 1967, the UO’s Outdoor Program has offered group excursions, bike and gear rentals, and clinics to help Ducks get active across Oregon’s spectacular natural ecosystem.

The Outdoor Program

Do Like Ducks Do

From iconic game-day sing-alongs to first-year IntroDUCKtion, these traditions define the UO experience.

Game Day Traditions

Crunch or Climb?

From cardio classes to rock climbing walls, these facilities help Ducks stay active.

PE and Recreation

Go Green (and Yellow)

Starting to see yourself in Eugene? Learn more about life as a Duck.
